title: Check a SPEI payment
Comprueba un pago SPEI
查证一笔 SPEI 付款
Kiểm tra một khoản SPEI
summary: Retrieve the CEP for an authorized existing payment and inspect its signature and transaction binding.
Obtén el CEP de un pago existente autorizado y revisa su firma y vinculación con la operación.
为已获授权的现有付款取得 CEP，查看签名与精确交易绑定。
Lấy CEP của khoản thanh toán đã được phép và kiểm tra chữ ký cùng liên kết giao dịch.
products.inputs: Operation date, tracking key, sending and receiving institution codes, account, amount and authorization reference.
products.output: Task status, original-evidence availability, signature status and exact transaction binding. Pending or unavailable remains inconclusive.
products.boundary: Does not initiate a transfer or prove present account control, identity or a safe payout. Source access restrictions can delay a task.
topics: A payment screenshot versus a signed CEP: what can your reconciliation job accept?
Recover a pending SPEI evidence request without creating a duplicate
products.audience: Mexico payment operations, reconciliation developers and finance automation teams

title: Match a CLABE name
Coteja el nombre CLABE
核对 CLABE 账户姓名
Đối chiếu tên CLABE
summary: Compare an expected beneficiary name with supported bank evidence for one authorized CLABE.
Compara el nombre esperado del beneficiario con evidencia bancaria admitida para una CLABE autorizada.
针对一个获准查询的 CLABE，把预期收款人姓名与受支持的银行证据核对。
Đối chiếu tên người thụ hưởng dự kiến với bằng chứng ngân hàng hỗ trợ cho một CLABE được phép.
products.inputs: CLABE, expected beneficiary name, holder type, current quote, authorization reference and stable request UUID.
products.output: Task state and name comparison with its evidence and charges; uncertain similarity requires review.
products.boundary: A quoted microtransfer may apply and requires explicit recipient and spending authority. This is not document identity or proof of current account control.
topics: Check a new beneficiary CLABE before changing payout details
Separate the transfer principal, source cost and fee in a bank-name quote
products.audience: Mexico marketplaces and payout integration teams

title: Check registration IP risk
Consulta riesgo de IP
检查注册 IP 风险
Kiểm tra rủi ro IP
summary: Request IP risk signals for one authorized registration event and keep the decision in your application.
Consulta señales de riesgo IP para un registro autorizado y conserva la decisión en tu aplicación.
为一个获授权的注册事件查询 IP 风险信号，由你的应用决定后续动作。
Tra cứu tín hiệu rủi ro IP cho một sự kiện đăng ký được phép; ứng dụng của bạn quyết định bước tiếp theo.
products.inputs: Authorized public IP address, consent reference, stable request UUID and explicit trial or paid mode.
products.output: IP risk signals and available explanatory evidence for the event; not an identity or fraud verdict.
products.boundary: Requires current supplier readiness and an eligible merchant. Paid mode requires confirmed prepaid credit. A risk score alone must not approve or reject a person.
topics: Use an IP risk signal in signup without calling it identity verification
Keep an unavailable IP score separate from low risk
products.audience: SaaS signup, marketplace and fraud operations developers

summary: Create a hosted verification link and retrieve its authoritative result after the person completes the journey.
Crea un enlace de verificación alojada y consulta el resultado autorizado después de que la persona complete el proceso.
创建托管核验链接，本人完成流程后读取权威结果。
Tạo liên kết xác minh lưu trữ và đọc kết quả chính thức sau khi người dùng hoàn tất.
products.inputs: Subject authorization reference, stable request UUID and explicit trial or paid mode; no document or face in the assistant chat.
products.output: Hosted URL, task state and authoritative completion status. Approved does not grant application permissions.
products.boundary: The person completes identity and liveness steps. New-person full approval acceptance remains pending; online purchases require payment-channel acceptance.

Recover a missing identity callback by reading the original task

Đối chiếu danh tính và tài khoản

Envía CURP y CLABE autorizadas para un cotejo de identidad y cuenta beneficiaria con cotización vinculada.
按绑定报价提交已获授权的 CURP 与 CLABE，完成一次身份与收款账户核对。
Gửi CURP và CLABE được phép để đối chiếu danh tính với tài khoản thụ hưởng theo báo giá ràng buộc.
products.inputs: Authorized CURP and CLABE, current quote, required evidence and consents, stable request UUID.
products.output: Verification grade, task status, evidence and charges. Supported grades and required actions follow the live quote.
products.boundary: No unconditional approval or arbitrary person lookup. No direct bank-CURP identifier claim, unsupported card input or transfer without the quote's explicit authorization.

Read the verification grade before deciding a beneficiary change

Chuẩn hóa số điện thoại
summary: Remove presentation separators from an international number and check E.164-shaped syntax locally.
Elimina separadores de un número internacional y comprueba su estructura E.164 de forma local.
在本地移除国际号码中的展示分隔符，检查 E.164 形式的结构。
Loại dấu phân cách của số quốc tế và kiểm tra cấu trúc E.164 ngay trên máy.
products.inputs: A phone string with explicit +country calling code; never infer a country from the visitor's location.
products.output: Normalized candidate and structure_valid. No carrier, allocation, reachability or ownership lookup.

summary: Check an 18-digit CLABE checksum locally before starting an account verification.
Comprueba localmente el dígito verificador de una CLABE de 18 dígitos antes de verificar la cuenta.
在发起账户核验前，本地检查 18 位 CLABE 的校验位。
Kiểm tra chữ số kiểm tra của CLABE 18 chữ số trên máy trước khi xác minh tài khoản.
products.inputs: An 18-digit CLABE, optionally separated by spaces or hyphens.
products.output: structure_valid, checksum_valid and institution code. No live bank query or account-ownership assertion.
products.boundary: A correct checksum does not prove that an account exists, can receive funds or belongs to a person.

CLABE checksum versus account ownership: two different answers
products.audience: Mexico payout forms and payment-file import developers

title: Explain a check result
Explica un resultado
解释核验结果
Giải thích kết quả xác minh
summary: Turn a documented status into a clear recovery step without sending a new request.
Convierte un estado documentado en un paso claro de recuperación sin enviar otra solicitud.
把已记录的状态解释为明确的恢复步骤，不发起新查询。
Giải thích trạng thái đã biết thành bước khôi phục rõ ràng mà không gửi yêu cầu mới.
products.inputs: A documented status code only; no raw identity documents, customer messages or credentials.

Recover after a timeout without paying twice for the same request
